sanskrit_verse:
बलेन चतुरङ्गेण यतो रञ्जयते प्रजाः ।
दीप्यमानः स्ववपुषा तेन राजाभिधीयते ॥
transliteration: balena caturaṅgena yato rañjayate prajāḥ / dīpyamānaḥ svavapuṣā tena rājābhidhīyate //
sph_interpretive_translation: He who governs the people through the fourfold strength—physical, intellectual, emotional, and spiritual—while illuminating his own Self, is rightfully called a King.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from the integration of holistic capacity, not coercion
Causation arises from self-luminous consciousness, not external force
Capacity-based responsibility includes mastery over four dimensions of being
Restoration logic requires rulers to embody and elevate collective consciousness
Consciousness alignment is foundational to legitimate sovereignty
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler lacks demonstrable mastery in physical, intellectual, emotional, and spiritual domains THEN legitimacy is suspended until capacity is restored
IF governance does not result in increased collective illumination THEN authority must be realigned with higher-consciousness agents
IF ruler's actions dim public consciousness THEN automatic restoration protocols initiate reintegration process
IF sovereignty is claimed without svavapuṣā (self-illumination) THEN claim is null and void under Dharma
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority must assess not only legal compliance but also the sovereign's capacity to uphold and elevate national consciousness. Legitimacy thresholds are tied to measurable alignment with svavapuṣā. Courts must enforce restoration of sovereignty when illumination declines.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: True Nyāya operates through the pramāṇa of svavapuṣā—self-evident consciousness—as the basis of rightful rule. Responsibility flows from the sequential unfolding of inner illumination into outer governance (anupūrvaśaḥ). Justice aligns action with inherent capacity rather than imposing punitive consequences.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svadhyaya protocol for ruler to reclaim self-luminosity
Activate Prajā-Saṃyama process to restore mutual illumination between ruler and ruled
Deploy Vapuṣā-Śuddhi mechanism to purify distortions in sovereign embodiment
Engage Chaturanga-Balādhāna Sadhana to rebuild holistic governance capacity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Sovereignty is validated only through svavapuṣā. Justice serves consciousness alone. All authority returns to its source in the illumined Self. This is the eternal, non-punitive law.
